actions.description: Tracking changes to the state or configuration of critical system level processes.

actions.description: Monitoring physical parameters and operator actions related to an operational environment.

actions.name: Operating System Monitoring
actions.description: The operating system software, for D3FEND's purposes, includes the kernel and its process management functions, hardware drivers, initialization or boot logic. It also includes and other key system daemons and their configuration. The monitoring or analysis of these components for unauthorized activity constitute **Operating System Monitoring**.

actions.name: Platform Uptime Monitoring
actions.description: Monitor the amount of time since the last power cycle or restart.

actions.name: Application Performance Monitoring
actions.description: Monitoring the count and duration of the application or program cycle.

actions.name: System Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.

actions.name: Software Update
actions.description: Replacing old software on a computer system component.

actions.name: Process Self-Modification Detection
actions.description: Detects processes that modify, change, or replace their own code at runtime.

actions.name: Credential Compromise Scope Analysis
actions.description: Determining which credentials may have been compromised by analyzing the user logon history of a particular system.

actions.name: Asset Vulnerability Enumeration
actions.description: Asset vulnerability enumeration enriches inventory items with knowledge identifying their vulnerabilities.
